authority.scope: Read-only semantic comparison of GTK2 assets referenced by the selected installed recipe and the current repository recipe.

renamed_directional_assets.definition: Four directions × five states × arrow glyph and stepper cell.

interpretation: The selected theme is not merely named differently: every directional arrow/stepper state uses the old asset naming and larger one-pixel geometry, and its GtkRange metrics differ from the current repository recipe. Restarting an application while this installed directory remains selected will not load the new repository files.
limits: This compares selected files and config; it does not inspect GTK2 in-memory style caches or prove actual application pixels.
No asset, profile, application, or live process was modified.
Installing the current recipe is outside the authorized preview-adapter scope of I167.

technical_coverage_estimate.basis: This confirms the selected installation is stale but adds no implementation change, VM held-state comparison, or human visual acceptance. It is not a fidelity score.
